headline: Wellington IT, supplier to about 40 Irish credit unions, was breached; payee details exposed, attacker not established.
summary: First draft. 6 sources (1 Tier 1, 5 Tier 2), 16 claims, 6 questions. Ireland's Department of Finance, with RTÉ, The Record and The Irish Times, establishes that an outside party got unauthorised access to saved-payee data at Wellington IT. Which fields, the 1.4 million request figure and the detection timeline are Reported. Money taken, the attacker, the member count and the method are Not established. Privacy check done: no names of people, no handles, no contact details.
author: Research agent
